record.original_question: A triangular norm, or t-norm, is an associative, commutative, non-decreasing function T: [0, 1]^2 -> [0, 1] with 1 as a neutral element. For p in (1, infinity), characterize all t-norms that are 1-Lipschitz with respect to the L_p norm; more generally, characterize all t-norms that are k-Lipschitz with respect to the L_p norm for a given k >= 1.

evidence.quote: A triangular norm (t-norm for short) T : [0, 1]^2 -> [0, 1] is an associative, commutative, non-decreasing function such that 1 acts as a neutral element.
Problem 3.1. Characterize all t-norms which are 1-Lipschitz (or, generally, k-Lipschitz with k >= 1) with respect to the L_p-norm for p in ]1, infinity[.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A triangular norm (t-norm) is a function $T:[0,1]^2\to[0,1]$ that is associative, commutative, non-decreasing in each argument, and admits $1$ as a neutral element (i.e. $T(x,1)=x$ for all $x\in[0,1]$).

For $p\in(1,\infty)$, equip $\mathbb{R}^2$ with the $L_p$-norm $\|(u,v)\|_p=(|u|^p+|v|^p)^{1/p}$. Given a real number $k\ge 1$, a t-norm $T$ is called $k$-Lipschitz with respect to the $L_p$-norm if
$$|T(x_1,y_1)-T(x_2,y_2)|\le k\,\|(x_1-x_2,\,y_1-y_2)\|_p \qquad \text{for all } (x_1,y_1),(x_2,y_2)\in[0,1]^2.$$

Problem. For each $p\in(1,\infty)$:
(a) Characterize all t-norms that are $1$-Lipschitz with respect to the $L_p$-norm.
(b) More generally, for every $k\ge 1$, characterize all t-norms that are $k$-Lipschitz with respect to the $L_p$-norm.
artifact.status_search_result: Work by A. Mesiarová ("k-lp-Lipschitz t-norms", Internat. J. Approx. Reason., 2007) shows that every k-Lp-Lipschitz t-norm is an ordinal sum of k-Lp-Lipschitz Archimedean t-norms, and characterizes the additive generators of Archimedean k-Lp-Lipschitz t-norms via a notion of k-p-convexity. Related results by Alsina, Mesiar and others address Lp-Lipschitz continuity of copulas. These give substantial structural characterizations, so the problem is at least partially solved, although a fully explicit closed-form description of all such t-norms (and of all k-p-convex generators) is not entirely settled.

status_evidence.title: k-lp-Lipschitz t-norms
status_evidence.snippet: k-lp-Lipschitz t-norms are shown to be ordinal sums of k-lp-Lipschitz Archimedean t-norms. Additive generators of k-lp-Lipschitz t-norms are characterized by means of k-p-convexity.
status_evidence.claim: The structural decomposition reduces the problem to characterizing Archimedean k-Lp-Lipschitz t-norms via k-p-convex additive generators.

status_evidence.title: Lipschitz continuity of copulas w.r.t. Lp-norms
status_evidence.snippet: Identifies 1-Lipschitz copulas with respect to some p-norm and shows preservation under ordinal/convex sums.
status_evidence.claim: Related characterizations exist for the copula setting under Lp-norms.
